traditional: Love, money, and pleasure fused with limitation, delay, and hard structure. The two act as one and the combined significations are hard to separate. The benefic Venus tempers the malefic Saturn.
modern: Affection and value meet limit. Loyalty, restraint in pleasure and love, and a strong sense of obligation. Fused, these drives are difficult to separate and ask to be consciously integrated rather than acted out blindly.

cyclic.meaning: A new cycle of connection and limit is sown: instinctive, full of potential, not yet conscious of itself.

business: Concentrated focus in this area. Loyal and hardworking; the risk is joyless striving and a belief that reward must be suffered for.
shadow: Indulgence and vanity fused with fear and rigidity, with no distance to tell them apart.
arcApplying: The two fuse and intensify as they close in.
arcSeparating: The fused theme peaks and discharges.

readerCopy.summary: A commitment becomes more meaningful when you understand what it will ask of you after the romantic, exciting, or hopeful part becomes ordinary.
readerCopy.body: A commitment becomes more meaningful when you understand what it will ask of you after the romantic, exciting, or hopeful part becomes ordinary. When Venus conjuncts Saturn, affection and value meet responsibility, making relationships, financial agreements, creative commitments, or promises feel more serious because time and consequence are now part of the decision. This does not have to make commitment feel heavy. It gives you a chance to choose the obligation knowingly and make sure the time, money, loyalty, or work it requires is something you can keep giving without resenting what you chose.
